## Brief

A 30-second radio jingle for Pedal Patch, a fictional neighbourhood bike repair shop whose promise is a puncture fixed in fifteen minutes while the customer waits. The brand name and the tagline "flat to fixed in fifteen" must both be sung; the form is hook first, one short verse, hook again, capped at sixteen bars so the whole thing fits a 30-second spot with room for a spoken address at the end.
